source_identity.candidate_source_policy: Each candidate was an uncommitted, precisely scoped temporary patch atop edbd888; all candidate source was reverted after it failed the directional gate, as required for this negative-only commit.
source_identity.prior_exact_main_interpretation: The integrated Leopard2 source was 2.32 percent slower than exact Leopard main in this target cell. The candidates below were screened against exact same-source Leopard2 first and were killed before another exact-main campaign.

focused_release_tests.candidate_startup_kat_scope: Ordinary and 65535-sentinel GF16 butterfly logs, one-byte-unaligned guarded ranges, and 2, 62, 64, 128, and 130-byte ALTMAP layouts were compared with the mature split IFFT plus XOR oracle.

validation.fuzzing: Not run; this bounded optimization pass used deterministic differential, startup-KAT, compatibility, and benchmark checks.

directional_method.purpose: Fast fail screen only; not promotion or authoritative evidence.
limitations: No confidence interval or fail-closed SMT-sibling isolation gate was run.
The host had unrelated sanitizer activity on another physical core during part of the pass.
Every candidate lost directionally, so spending an isolated authoritative campaign on it would not be scientifically useful.

candidates.hypothesis: Keep all four GF16 rows live through the final inverse radix-four layers and XOR directly into the accumulator, removing one full temporary write/read pass.
candidates.implementation: Optional AVX-512VL-only ff16 inverse-butterfly4-XOR range callback, exact-gated to AUTO legacy-high K=1000, R=200, 64-KiB shards and its 32-KiB execution tiles.
candidates.static_result: Generated assembly rebroadcast the 24 GF16 nibble tables inside each 64-byte loop iteration, overwhelming the saved temporary traffic.

candidates.hypothesis: Pack each multiplier's four nibble tables into ZMM lanes so six invariant 64-byte table vectors replace repeated YMM broadcasts while retaining direct final accumulation.
candidates.implementation: AVX-512BW VPSHUFB across packed 128-bit lanes followed by cross-lane XOR reduction, with invariant tables loaded once per four-row group.
candidates.static_result: Packed lookup construction, lane reduction, and wide-vector execution cost substantially more than the mature split schedule.

candidates.hypothesis: Four smaller end-to-end byte tiles may improve cache residency enough to close the residual exact-main gap while halving scratch again.
candidates.implementation: Change only the exact qualified cell's maximum execution tile from 32 KiB to 16 KiB.

candidates.hypothesis: Three approximately 21.8-KiB balanced passes may provide a crossover between two 32-KiB and four 16-KiB passes.
candidates.implementation: Set the exact cell's maximum tile to 24 KiB; the layout selected three balanced aligned passes.
candidates.method_note: Single candidate run against the immediately preceding control bracket; sufficiently negative for a kill decision but not an ABBA result.

artifact_retention_note: The /tmp paths are ignored, machine-local artifacts and are not expected to survive a machine move. Their hashes and all decision-bearing measurements are retained in this committed record.

conclusion.kill_decision: All four bounded candidates are slower than the current Leopard2 source in the target cell; do not spend an authoritative exact-main campaign or production complexity on them.
conclusion.remaining_hypothesis: The residual exact-main gap is more likely in coarse whole-transform call shape or portable-translation-unit instruction shape than in final-stage temporary traffic or smaller byte tiles. That is a larger, separately reviewable experiment.
